blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—An anti-scam advocacy campaign organization opposed the blocking of social media platform ‘Discord’ in the Philippines. The group believes blanket blocking affects Filipinos who use the platform for work. It also said legitimate users should not be made “collateral damage.” Discord is a social media platform for creating and participating in online communities. It was originally developed as a voice-chat service for gamers. “Blanket blocking is a reactive policy that affects not only bad actors,” said Scam Watch Pilipinas in a statement on Thursday. The scam watchdog added that the policy affects “Filipinos who legitimately use Discord for virtual assistance, […]...
